posts.title: Ignatius Rules of Discernment Prayers
posts.description: I learned about Ignatius's 14 rules of discernment through Timothy Gallagher and his excellent book Ignatian Discernment in Daily Life -- Finding God in All Things . The rules encouraged me so deeply that I decided to write a prayer for each one as a way of entering more deeply into them. May God bless you through them. Apple Podcasts Prayer for freedom from sin (Ignatius rule 1) Prayer for growth
